name: taba
description: Queues, distributors and access tokens of the Taba messaging system.
attribution: This Pulumi package is based on the [`taba` Terraform Provider](https://github.com/rafaelpontani/terraform-provider-taba).

nodejs.packageDescription: Queues, distributors and access tokens of the Taba messaging system.

caCertFile.description: Path of a PEM file with a private certificate authority. Conflicts with `caCertPem`.

caCertPem.description: PEM of a private certificate authority that signs the API certificate. Conflicts with `caCertFile`. Default: the `TABA_CA_CERT` environment variable (a PEM or a file path).

createOrUpdate.description: Default of the `createOrUpdate` attribute of every resource: when creating a queue, distributor or token that already exists in the cluster, take it over (and bring it to the declared configuration) instead of failing. Off by default, because it takes over in silence what may belong to another configuration. Default: the `TABA_CREATE_OR_UPDATE` environment variable (`true` or `false`), or `false`.

endpoint.description: URL of the client API (the cluster load balancer), such as `https://taba.example.com:8080`. Default: the `TABA_URL` environment variable.

requestTimeout.description: Timeout of each call, as a Go duration (`30s`, `1m`). Default: `30s`.

retryMaxWait.description: Total wait, as a Go duration (`3m`, `90s`), between the attempts of a call that gets `429` or `503`: each one waits for the `Retry-After` (5 s from a node of the cluster) or 1, 2, 4… up to 64 seconds, and no attempt is made whose wait would pass this total. A node that crashed answers for the definitions it owns until the others vote it out (about a minute). It also bounds the creations of a token that get `503 cluster.quorum-unavailable`, each one after revoking what the previous one may have created. `0s`: no new attempt. Default: `3m`.

token.description: Access token (`Authorization: Bearer`). Queues and distributors need `create` and `manage` within their prefixes; tokens need the root token (or an `admin` one for tokens that are not `admin`). Default: the `TABA_TOKEN` environment variable. Without it, the calls go without authentication.

expiresAt.description: Deadline (RFC 3339), or null when the token does not expire.

topicPrefixes.description: Prefixes the token is limited to (empty: every topic).

effectiveMaxDeliveries.description: The maxDeliveries in force.

idleTimeout.description: Volatile queue only: seconds without a consumer until removal.

maxDeliveries.description: Declared deliveries before the dead-letter (null: the node default).

maxMessageBytes.description: Declared maximum message size (null: the node default).

prefixes.description: Distributor only: the destination prefixes (null on a queue).

source.description: Dead-letter queue only: the queue it belongs to.

ttl.description: Declared message lifetime, in seconds (null: the node default).

type.description: `queue` or `distributor`.

createOrUpdate.description: When creating, take over a topic with this name that already exists instead of failing: it gets the declared `prefixes` and `tags`. A queue with this name is recreated as a distributor only if it holds no message; otherwise nothing changes and the creation fails. Not set: the provider `createOrUpdate` (default `false`). It is only used when the resource is created; afterwards the resource belongs to this state like any other, and a `destroy` removes it.

name.description: Name: 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`, case-sensitive, not ending in `-dead-letter`. Changing it replaces the distributor.

prefixes.description: Name prefixes of the queues each publication is copied to (1 to 20, of 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`). A change applies to the publications after it.

tags.description: Telemetry tags (up to 20; key of 1 to 64 and value of 0 to 128 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-.:`). They do not affect behaviour. Default: none.

forceDestroy.description: Remove the queue even when it holds messages (they are lost). With `false`, the removal is refused while the queue or its dead-letter holds a message. It is read from the state, so set it to `true` and apply before a `destroy` or a replacement. Default: `false`.

maxMessageBytes.description: Maximum size of a message, in bytes (1 up to the node `message.hard-limit`). Not set: the node default (`effectiveMaxMessageBytes`).

createOrUpdate.description: When creating, take over the token with this `name` that already exists instead of creating another (names are not unique): it must be the only one with the name and have the declared `permissions` and `topicPrefixes`, and its `expiresAt` changes to the declared one. Its secret cannot be recovered: `token` stays null (use `-replace` for a new one). Not set: the provider `createOrUpdate` (default `false`). It is only used when the resource is created; afterwards the resource belongs to this state like any other, and a `destroy` removes it.

expiresAt.description: Deadline (RFC 3339, such as `2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`); it must be in the future. Not set: the token does not expire. Changes in place. An expired token disappears from the server: the next `plan` then refuses the configuration until `expiresAt` moves to the future (a new token) or the resource is removed.

name.description: Name: 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-.:`. It is not unique on the server. Changes in place.

permissions.description: Permissions: one or more of `publish`, `consume`, `create`, `manage`, `admin`. Changing them replaces the token.

secret.description: The secret to send in `Authorization: Bearer` (`tb_<id>.<secret>`). Only known when the token was created here: null after an import.

topicPrefixes.description: Limit the token to the topics whose name starts with one of these prefixes (up to 20; 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`). Empty: every topic. Not allowed with `admin`. Changing them replaces the token. Default: none.
